title: Thursday at Mister Omar's Shop
title_zh: 星期四在奥马尔先生的小店
setting: A small, busy corner shop with a pizza oven and a food counter.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron)

sentences.en: On Thursday, Ben and his sister Lily go shopping.
sentences.zh: 星期四，本和他的妹妹莉莉去买东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) walk hand in hand along the street towards a small corner shop.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben and Lily going to the shop; the day Thursday can't be shown.

sentences.en: Mister Omar opens the door of his shop.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔先生打开了他小店的门。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) opens the glass door of his small corner shop with a smile.

sentences.en: A long line of people waits inside.
sentences.zh: 店里有一长队人在等着。
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside the busy shop, a long line of customers waits at the food counter; Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) stand at the end.

sentences.en: Lily buys toothpaste and a pair of socks.
sentences.zh: 莉莉买了牙膏和一双袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) puts a tube of toothpaste and a pair of striped socks on the counter.

sentences.en: Ben reads the menu and wants a pizza.
sentences.zh: 本看了菜单，想要一个比萨饼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks up at a menu board with pictures of pizzas and drinks and points at a pizza.

sentences.en: Omar bakes it over a strong fire.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔在旺火上烤比萨饼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) slides a pizza into a brick oven with big, bright flames.

sentences.en: "Help yourself to the last banana," he says.
sentences.zh: “最后一根香蕉你自己拿吧。”他说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) smiles and holds out a fruit bowl with only one banana in it to Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar offering the one banana left; his exact words can't be shown.

sentences.en: "Listen, Ben, do not forget your bag!"
sentences.scene_prompt: At the shop door, Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) calls out and holds up a school bag while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), holding a pizza box, turns round.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar calling Ben back and holding up his bag; the spoken words can't be shown.
